title: Mitglieder einladen und Alarmempfänger pflegen
description: As an organisation admin, I want to invite colleagues and configure who receives security alerts, so that the right people are notified.

acceptance_criteria.given: the acting user has the role ORG_ADMIN
acceptance_criteria.when: the admin invites a colleague with the role DEVELOPER
acceptance_criteria.then: the API responds with 202 and creates a single-use, time-limited invitation
and: the invitation is bound to the acting organisation and to the role DEVELOPER
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-006-membership-and-alert-recipients.feature: An invitation adds a member with a chosen role

acceptance_criteria.given: the acting user has the role DEVELOPER
acceptance_criteria.when: the user attempts to send an invitation
acceptance_criteria.then: the API responds with 403 and no invitation is created

acceptance_criteria.given: an organisation has no security admin recipient configured
acceptance_criteria.when: a prompt version of that organisation becomes flagged
acceptance_criteria.then: the alert is delivered to the organisation admins
and: the delivery attempt is recorded with the actual recipients
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-006-membership-and-alert-recipients.feature: Without a configured security admin the alert goes to the organisation admins
